# Roles

The access groups the product adds, what each includes and what it is for.

| Role | Category | Includes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **USL Accountant Review** (`Accounting / USL Accountant Review`) | Accounting / Accounting | `Show Accounting Features - Readonly` | Read-only accounting access plus scoped, audited declaration-review decisions for allowed companies. |
| **Accounting Evidence Reader** (`Accounting Evidence / Accounting Evidence Reader`) | Documents / Accounting Evidence | `Role / User` |  |
| **Administrator** (`B2C Sales and Inventory / Administrator`) | Sales / B2C Sales and Inventory | `Accounting / Administrator`, `Analytic Accounting`, `B2C Sales and Inventory / Operator`, `B2C Sales and Inventory / Sensitive provider evidence`, `Inventory / Administrator`, `Manufacturing / Administrator`, `Purchase / Administrator`, `Sales / Administrator` | Configure channels, govern mappings and evidence, and unlock accounting sessions. |
| **Operator** (`B2C Sales and Inventory / Operator`) | Sales / B2C Sales and Inventory | `B2C Sales and Inventory / Read-only reviewer`, `Inventory / User`, `Manufacturing / User`, `Purchase / User`, `Sales / User: Own Documents Only` | Operate B2C records and native Sales, Inventory, Manufacturing and Purchase workflows. |
| **Read-only reviewer** (`B2C Sales and Inventory / Read-only reviewer`) | Sales / B2C Sales and Inventory | `Show Accounting Features - Readonly` | Inspect B2C commerce, mappings, sessions and linked business evidence without changing them. |
| **Sensitive provider evidence** (`B2C Sales and Inventory / Sensitive provider evidence`) | Sales / B2C Sales and Inventory | `B2C Sales and Inventory / Read-only reviewer` | Inspect access-scoped provider payloads that can contain customer personal data. |
| **Distribution Audit Reader** (`Distribution Audit Reader`) |  | `Role / User` | Inspect attributable Agent mutations and protected actions without changing audit history. |
| **Accounting Reviewer** (`Distribution Role / Accounting Reviewer`) | USL Distribution / Distribution Role | `Accounting / USL Accountant Review`, `Accounting Evidence / Accounting Evidence Reader`, `Show Full Accounting Features` | Annual-review Accounting work in unlocked periods, including draft adjustments, posting, reset, and reconciliation; excludes locks and permanent deletion. |
| **Full Product Administrator** (`Distribution Role / Full Product Administrator`) | USL Distribution / Distribution Role | `Accounting / Administrator`, `B2C Sales and Inventory / Administrator`, `Documents / Document Administrator`, `Employees / Administrator`, `Expenses / Administrator`, `Official Correspondence / Official correspondence manager`, `Platform Billing / Administrator`, `Project / Administrator`, `Role / Administrator`, `Technical Documentation`, `USL Sign / Sign administrator` | All Distribution applications and technical administration through an attributable user identity. Irreversible Actions remain a separate capability. |
| **Technical Administrator** (`Distribution Role / Technical Administrator`) | USL Distribution / Distribution Role | `Access Rights`, `B2C Sales and Inventory / Operator`, `B2C Sales and Inventory / Sensitive provider evidence`, `Distribution Audit Reader`, `Documents / Document Administrator`, `Project / Administrator`, `Show Accounting Features - Readonly`, `Technical Documentation` | Operate B2C, Projects and Documents and inspect technical configuration; security, locks, audit deletion and irreversible maintenance remain protected. |
| **Document Administrator** (`Documents / Document Administrator`) | Documents / Documents | `Documents / Document User`, `Documents / HR Document Reader` |  |
| **Document User** (`Documents / Document User`) | Documents / Documents | `Role / User` |  |
| **HR Document Reader** (`Documents / HR Document Reader`) | Documents / Documents | `Documents / Document User` |  |
| **Feedback Agent (read-only service)** (`Feedback Agent (read-only service)`) |  |  | Dedicated non-human identity used only by the Projects MCP. It must not be an Internal User or a Feedback Maintainer. |
| **AI Agent** (`Identity Type / AI Agent`) | USL Distribution / Identity Type | `Role / User`, `Technical Documentation` | Marks an autonomous identity. Combine with application groups; irreversible actions remain explicitly denied. |
| **Unpack supplier packs** (`Inventory Pack Processing / Unpack supplier packs`) | Supply Chain / Inventory Pack Processing | `B2C Sales and Inventory / Read-only reviewer`, `Inventory / User`, `Manufacturing / User` | Receive configured supplier packs and convert them through their exact native unpacking recipe. |
| **Administrator** (`Platform Billing / Administrator`) | Accounting / Platform Billing | `Accounting / Administrator`, `Analytic Accounting`, `Platform Billing / Operator` | Full platform billing access, including configuration and eligible record deletion. |
| **Operator** (`Platform Billing / Operator`) | Accounting / Platform Billing | `Basic`, `Platform Billing / Read-only` | Prepare, generate, post and reconcile platform billing sessions without configuring platforms. |
| **Read-only** (`Platform Billing / Read-only`) | Accounting / Platform Billing | `Show Accounting Features - Readonly` | Inspect platform billing configurations, sessions, payouts and linked accounting evidence. |
| **Feedback Maintainer** (`Product Feedback / Feedback Maintainer`) | Services / Product Feedback | `Role / User` | Manage the shared Product Feedback Project and its canonical card fields. |
| **Irreversible Actions** (`Special Capabilities / Irreversible Actions`) | USL Distribution / Special Capabilities | `Distribution Audit Reader` | Permit permanent deletion, lock changes, authorization changes, destructive technical maintenance, and other protected actions. |
| **Evidence reviewer** (`USL Sign / Evidence reviewer`) | Productivity / USL Sign | `Role / User` |  |
| **Identity reviewer** (`USL Sign / Identity reviewer`) | Productivity / USL Sign | `Role / User` |  |
| **Sign administrator** (`USL Sign / Sign administrator`) | Productivity / USL Sign | `Sign / Administrator`, `USL Sign / Evidence reviewer`, `USL Sign / Identity reviewer`, `USL Sign / Template manager`, `USL Sign / Trust-level override` |  |
| **Sign user** (`USL Sign / Sign user`) | Productivity / USL Sign | `Sign / User: Own Documents Only` |  |
| **Template manager** (`USL Sign / Template manager`) | Productivity / USL Sign | `USL Sign / Sign user` |  |
| **Trust-level override** (`USL Sign / Trust-level override`) | Productivity / USL Sign | `USL Sign / Sign user` |  |
